contract_data.basis: 68 of 97 rigs carry source/source_url/confidence fields; remaining 29 rigs are unsourced legacy entries.
contract_data.notes: Source coverage is strongest for Transocean, Hanwha Drilling, Odfjell Drilling, Dolphin Drilling, Stena Drilling, Vantage Drilling, Valaris drillships, Seadrill and selected Noble rigs. Valaris and Borr jack-up rows are the main remaining gap. 2026-10-12: Valaris MS-1 removed (sold for recycling Sep 2026 per Valaris Oct 7 release); Valaris DS-18 note updated (PETRONAS Suriname 2-well).

dayrates.basis: FSR-verified where source_url exists; otherwise indicative legacy value. Implied values are marked separately and should not be treated as disclosed dayrates.
dayrates.notes: Use rig-level confidence and day_rate_basis before treating a day_rate_kusd value as verified. Unsourced jack-up rates should not be used as contract observations.

rig_specs.basis: Company fleet status reports and public rig specification sheets where available.
rig_specs.notes: Rig specs may describe design capability rather than current contractual operating conditions.

data_quality.coverage_note_2026_10_08: Transocean·Valaris 부유식 리그를 2026-08 FSR 기준 전수 반영(Transocean 드릴십 8척, Valaris 드릴십 6척 + MS-1 추가). 현재 FSR에 없는 Deepwater Stavanger, Valaris DPS-1 제거(선단 이탈). Valaris 잭업 중 일부(ARO 임대분, 북해·벤인 잭업 다수)와 Noble·Seadrill 등 타사는 기존 추적 범위 유지 — 전수 아님. Noble: 2026-07-27 FSR 기준 전면 재구성(부유식 23척 + UH 잭업 5척). 기존 Noble 9척 중 Regina Allen·Resolve는 현 Noble 선단에 없는 잭업이 드릴십/반잠수식으로 잘못 기재돼 있어 제거, Valiant·Developer·Gerry de Souza 계약 오류 정정. Noble Patriot(수심 1,500ft P&A 반잠수식)은 심해 범위 밖이라 제외. Seadrill: 2026-08-10 FSR 기준 Sonangol 소유 관리 드릴십 2척·계류 반잠수식 3척 추가.
data_quality.coverage_note_2026_10_08_en: Transocean and Valaris floaters fully reconciled to Aug 2026 FSRs (added 8 Transocean drillships, 6 Valaris drillships + MS-1). Removed Deepwater Stavanger and Valaris DPS-1, which no longer appear in current FSRs (left the fleet). Some Valaris jack-ups (ARO-leased units, many North Sea/Benin jack-ups) and other contractors keep their existing tracking scope — not exhaustive. Noble: fully rebuilt from the 2026-07-27 FSR (23 floaters + 5 UH jack-ups). Of the previous 9 Noble rigs, Regina Allen and Resolve were removed (jack-ups no longer in Noble's fleet, mislabeled as drillship/semisub), and contract errors on Valiant, Developer and Gerry de Souza were corrected. Noble Patriot (1,500ft P&A semisub) excluded as outside deepwater scope. Seadrill: per 2026-08-10 FSR, added 2 Sonangol-owned managed drillships and 3 stacked semisubs.
data_quality.removed_2026_10_13_rigs: Borr Heimdal·Borr Vale·Borr Arabia IV 삭제 — Borr 2026-08-11 선단현황표(SEC 6-K, 29척)에 없는 리그로 실재 확인 안 됨(Borr의 Arabia는 I~III, 'Vali'는 리비아 Mellitah 계약의 별개 리그). Borr Frigg 삭제 — 현재 Borr 선단에 없음.
data_quality.removed_2026_10_13_rigs_en: Removed Borr Heimdal, Borr Vale, Borr Arabia IV — not in Borr's 2026-08-11 fleet status report (SEC 6-K, 29 rigs); existence unverified (Borr's Arabia rigs are I–III; 'Vali' is a separate rig on a Mellitah contract in Libya). Removed Borr Frigg — not in Borr's current fleet.
data_quality.borr_full_fleet_2026_10_13: Borr 2026-08-11 선단현황표 기준 29척 전수 반영: 누락 14척 추가, 기존 15척의 일괄 입력 사양(전부 KFELS Super B Bigfoot·Keppel FELS 등)을 FSR의 설계·건조연도로 정정하고 미확인 사양은 null.
data_quality.borr_full_fleet_2026_10_13_en: All 29 Borr rigs reconciled to the 2026-08-11 fleet status report: 14 missing rigs added; the blanket-filled specs on the existing 15 (all 'KFELS Super B Bigfoot / Keppel FELS') corrected to FSR design and build year, unverified specs set to null.
data_quality.valaris_jackups_2026_10_13: Valaris 잭업 FSR(2026-08-05) 기준 전수 반영: 누락 18척 추가(북해 HE·Legacy·Benign·ARO 임대), 기존 10척 사양을 FSR 설계·인도연도로 정정. 매각 리그 제외(104·109 2026-06/07, 111 2026-09 재활용).
data_quality.valaris_jackups_2026_10_13_en: All Valaris jack-ups reconciled to the 2026-08-05 FSR: 18 missing rigs added (North Sea HE, legacy, benign, leased to ARO); specs on the existing 10 corrected to FSR design and delivery year. Sold rigs excluded (104 and 109 Jun/Jul 2026, 111 recycled Sep 2026).
